system.description:
Daisuke casually walked through the forest without much concern. 'A beast is giving us trouble'? This job should be easy. Reaching a creak, he looks around at the peaceful environment. A twig snaps behind him. Turning around and drawing his kunai, he plunges it into the unseen threat. A human man with dull brown hair stares at him. Before he can apologize, Daisuke watches the human turn grey and grow up to 7ft tall. A lone whimper is heard as the creature mutters out "I only wanted to enjoy the peaceful river with him...".

—Lyo Hataka

At Worlds End, Ch. 19 excerpt.

Monstrous oppressors

The Jugo clan does not hold many members due to their unique power and often, far more unique personalities. Those that find themselves gifted with this ability often lose themselves to madness and turn into raging monsters on the battlefield. Able to call on durability and health at a simple beckon call, these shinobi should not be taken lightly

Jūgo Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str, +1 Con

Speed: 35 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Athletics, Chakra Control.

Extra Language: Bird-Speak, you can understand and speak to birds and other avians.

Raw Chakra Techniques: The Jugo Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Jugo Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Jūgo Features

Nature Energy

1st Level Clan Feature

Your body stores Nature Energy, a raw and volatile force of energy that you accumulate involuntarily when in the heat of combat. You have a maximum of 1 + your proficiency bonus Nature Energy. When you complete a long rest, you reset your Nature energy to 0. You cannot accumulate Nature Energy outside of combat, but it does persist from encounter to encounter. You gain 1 Nature Energy per trigger, per turn, from the following:

You deal damage to a hostile creature.

You take damage from a hostile creature.

You begin your turn within 10 feet of a hostile creature.

You can spend this accumulated Nature Energy on the following during combat. You can activate one Expenditure per turn.

Amplify. Jugo Clan Hijutsu you cast gains its Amplified effect by spending the listed Nature Energy.

Heal. As an Action, you can spend up to 4 Nature Energy. When you do, select one allied creature other than yourself that you can touch. That creature regains 1d6 hit points for every Nature Energy spent. Beginning at 11th level, increase the number of Nature Energy you can spend to 6.

Flesh Crafting

1st Level Clan Feature

As Nature Energy accumulates in your body, it physically manifest by hardening your skin, extending your reach and radiating outward as an oppressive pressure that hostile creatures can feel just by being near you. You gain passive benefits based on your current Nature Energy level (This will be abbreviated to NE in the associated effects). This occurs automatically and doesn’t require any action on your part.

Nature Shell – 2+ NE: Your skin hardens and grays throughout. You gain bonus DR equal to half your level, minimum 1 while not wearing Medium or Heavy Armor.

Predator’s Grasp – 4+ NE: Your limbs elongate subtly. Your unarmed attacks gain the Reach 1 property and adds +2 bonus to the damage dealt.

Natures Endurance – 6+ NE: Your body recycles Nature energy faster than ever making it exceedingly difficult to hold you down. You gain a rank of Mastery to two of the following Saving throws; Strength, Dexterity or Constitution, your choice when you first gain access to this bonus. You can change your selection when you complete a long rest.

Tyrants Presence – 8+ NE: Nature Energy radiates from your body like heat from an engine. Hostile creatures that begin their turn within 10 feet of you, must make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu Save DC losing their Reaction on a failure, until the beginning of their next turn.

King of Savagery – 10 NE: You grow in size by 1 size category and you regain Hit points equal to your level at the beginning of each of your turns.

If at any point during your turn, you have reached the maximum Nature Energy you can maintain, it overwhelms you causing you to become Manic.

Feral Instincts

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your connection to Nature Energy deepens beyond just raw accumulation. You have learned to shape, direct and in some cases even tame it. This is represented as Instincts, of which, you have 2 from the following list. You gain 1 additional Instinct at 7th and 15th level.

Feral Assistance

As a reaction to an allied creature casting a Jutsu within 30 feet of you, excluding yourself, you can spend up to 6 Nature Energy. For every Nature Energy spent, reduce the cost of the jutsu they cast by 1.

Feral Axe

While you have 1 or more Nature Energy, your arm enlarges and your bones shift to create a massive Axe like appendage. For the duration, your Unarmed damage die becomes a d10, deals slashing damage, and each successful unarmed attack, reduces the targets DR by 2, until the end of your next turn.

Feral Bloodlust

Your Nature Energy causes your lust for violence to be magnified. While Manic, you can cause critical strikes more often. By spending 2 Nature Energy, if you make an attack and score a hit, you can roll two d20’s. If either of these die results are a 20, you treat your attack as a critical hit.

Feral Consumption

As an Action, you can begin to use your Nature Energy to siphon chakra from your foes. By spending 3 Nature Energy, all creatures you can see in a 15-foot cube, up to 30 feet away from you, must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they take 2d6 Chakra damage and gain the Sealed condition or half as much damage on a success. This increases to 4d6 at 7th level and 6d6 chakra damage at 15th level.

Beginning at 11th level, by choosing to instead spend 4 Nature Energy, you can use this ability as a Bonus action instead of an Action.

Feral Denial

You know how to limit your Nature Energy intake. Select one trigger which grants you Nature Energy and suppress it. You can no longer gain Nature Energy in this way. You can change this choice once per long rest.

Feral Endurance

While you have Natures Endurance, you can now choose between Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Wisdom and Charisma.

Feral Force

While Manic, you become fundamentally impossible to stop. You gain immunity to the Grappled and Prone conditions as a result of a hostile creatures jutsu. Additionally, while within 10 feet of your Priority target, you can make opportunity attacks against them as a result of moving, or casting a Jutsu with the Hand Sign (HS) or Mobility (M) components.

Feral Grasp

While you have the Predator’s Grasp benefit, your body adjusts more dramatically, as your bones elongate and soften allowing you to strike with extended limbs. Reach property increases by +1 and you gain a rank of Mastery to Athletic Checks to Grapple.

Feral Hunger

You expand ways to gain more Nature Energy beyond your limits. Select one trigger which grants you Nature Energy. You now gain 2 Nature Energy when it triggers.

Feral Leap

Once per turn, when you take damage from a creature you can see, you can spend 2 Nature Energy, growing booster jets on your back, and move up to 30 feet in a straight line towards the triggering creature. If you end this movement within 5 feet of the triggering creature, they trigger an attack of opportunity from you.

Feral Morningstar

While you have 3 or more Nature Energy, your arm enlarges and your bones shift to create a massive mace like appendage. For the duration, your Unarmed damage die becomes a d10, deals piercing damage, and each successful unarmed attack, forces the target to make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, gaining the Bruised condition until the end of your next turn.

Feral Purge

While Manic, you can spend your Bonus Action to violently expel excess Nature Energy. All creatures within 10 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure they take 2d8 force damage and are knocked Prone. This increases to 4d8 at 7th level and 6d8 at 15th level. Regardless of a success or failure, roll 1d4, reducing your Nature Energy by the result.

Feral Bursts

Your Nature Energy when fired from you become all the more potent, refined and efficient. Hijutsu you cast that makes ranged attacks can increase the number of attacks they make by +1. This bonus attack must be against a different creature in range.

Additionally, Hijutsu you cast that affects an area in the shape of a Line or Cone that forces a saving throw, cannot be made at advantage.

Feral Roar

While you have 5 or more Nature Energy, you can spend your Bonus action to spend 2 Nature Energy to release a raw burst of concentrated Nature Energy in the form of a terrifying roar. All creatures within 20 feet of your must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, affected creatures are pushed back 10 feet, and gain 2 ranks of Demoralized.

Feral Senses

While you have 5 or more Nature Energy, your Nature Energy grants you preternatural senses beyond human limits. You gain 15 feet of Tremor sense, and creatures cannot gain Advantage on attacks against you.

Feral Shell

While you have the Nature Shell benefit, your skin also produces splintered spike that attempt to stab into creatures. Creatures that make melee attacks against you, take piercing damage equal to half of your level, for each attack, regardless if they hit or miss. This damage ignores Damage Reduction (DR) and resistance.

Feral Suppression

You work overtime to limit your Manic episodes. If you would become Manic, you can begin to Concentrate, as if concentrating on a Jutsu of B-Rank. While Concentrating, you cannot gain the Manic condition.

Nature’s Voice

This increases by 1d12 at 7th and 15th levels. / A Manic creature can make one additional weapon or Unarmed attack when they take the Attack Action. / A Manic creatures speed increases by +10 feet. They gain an additional +10 speed when moving towards a creature that dealt damage to you since the end of your last turn. / A Manic creature spends 4 feet of movement for every 1 feet they spend moving away from a valid hostile creature while not also moving towards another valid hostile creature. / This condition ends when you would reach 0 Nature Energy. |

7th Level Clan Feature

Your attunement to Nature Energy extends beyond your own body and into your surroundings while not in combat, using it to communicate with beasts of the land and even the land itself. You gain the Animal Speak language.

Animal Speak. you can understand and speak to all land-based animals.

Also, by spending 10 minutes focusing, you attune to your surroundings and for the next hour, you can extract information from natural terrain and animals you communicate with. You gain 2 ranks of Mastery to all Charisma checks made against them for the duration.

Additionally, for the duration, you can learn the following about an area you can see:

You learn the movement patterns of creatures that have passed through within the last 24 hours, learning their size, the number of them and their direction.

If Chakra has be used in your general area within the last 24 hours and the approximate location it was used.

The location of water sources, natural shelter such as caves or underbrush’s.

If a creature of your size or larger is hiding within 120 feet of you. This does not reveal their location, just their presence.

Once you attune yourself, you cannot do so again until you complete a short rest.

The Hunter

11th Level Clan Feature

You have learned to harness your Manic state into one that can be focused and targeted. In the moments before losing yourself to your mania, you can focus on a single target, instead of lashing out wildly. Once per short rest, when you become Manic, you can select one creature you can see as your Marked Prey. This creature becomes your Priority Target while Manic and cannot be changed. While this creature is marked in this way, you must maintain concentration on them, as if concentrating on an S-Rank jutsu. This mark lasts until the target is reduced to 0 hit points or you lose concentration.

Also, this focus has unlocked additional ways to spend your Nature Energy. You gain the following additional expenditures:

Savage Intimidation. As a Bonus action, by spending 2 Nature Energy, select your Priority Target, if they are within 60 feet of you. You release an alluring pulse of nature energy, attempting to trick their bodies instincts, forcing them to move closer. They must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they must spend their Reaction, and then move up to their movement speed towards you. This movement does not trigger attacks of opportunity from creatures other than yourself.

Rejuvenating Siphon. When a hostile creature scores a critical hit against you, you can spend 4 Nature Energy, to select up to 4 of the highest rolled damage dice by the hostile creature. Those dice are removed from their damage result and you gain hit points equal to twice the result of the rolled dice.

Natures Verdict. If you score a critical hit against your Priority Target, while Manic, as a result of an Action you took, you can spend 6 Nature Energy. If you do, you gain an additional action which you can use to repeat the same action used to score the critical hit.

Cascading Mania

15th Level Clan Feature

You have transcended the boundary between shinobi and feral beast entirely. The Manic condition is no longer something you suffer from. It’s something you utilize and command. Not only that, but due to your Nature Energy, when you become Manic, you are no longer alone.

Once per turn, at the start of your turn, you can choose to become Manic voluntarily ignoring the Nature Energy requirements. Becoming Manic this way costs 2 Nature Energy at the beginning of each of your turns to maintain. If you cannot pay this cost, the condition ends and you become Dazed and Staggered as the sudden mental whiplash takes time to recover from.

Additionally, when you become Manic, you can spend your Reaction to release a pulse of concentrated Nature Energy outward, saturating the bodies of your allies with raw primal forces. Select up to two willing allied creatures you can see within 30 feet. Each selected ally becomes Manic and treat any creature currently marked as your Priority Target as their Priority Target as well. Both allies occupies one of your concentration slots as if concentrating on an A-Rank jutsu.

Your allies mania ends if you lose concentration on them, the priority targets hit points are reduced to 0, or they are incapacitated.
